name: tokens
title: Lumen Token Graph (DTCG 2025.10)
description: The full Lumen token graph emitted by Style Dictionary v5. Includes primitives (color, spacing, radius, typography, elevation, motion, glass, mesh, noise, gradient), semantic layer (surface, text, border, action), and the mode rebind layers (restrained, expressive). Consumers can install this single registry item to get every CSS variable the Lumen system uses. The audit-dashboard `globals.css` mirrors these for runtime; consumer apps install once and reference via `var(--surface-canvas)`, `var(--color-spring-500)`, etc.
